name: Mailchimp
shortDescription: Email campaigns. The Free plan includes 250 contacts and 500 sends a month.
longDescription: Mailchimp's help center says the Free Marketing plan includes up to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month, with a daily send limit of 250. The pricing page lists a 14-day trial of the Standard or Essentials plan.
pricingNotes: Help center: Free plan up to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month. Paid tiers vary by contact total, so startingPrice stays empty.
freeTierNotes: Up to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month.
bestFor: Sending email campaigns to a small list
notIdealFor: A sender who will pass 250 contacts on the Free plan
strength: Mailchimp's help center says the Free plan includes up to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month.
weakness: Sending pauses if that Free plan passes 250 contacts, and paid tiers depend on the contact total.

useCaseFit.marketing-promotions: Free plan sends email campaigns to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month.
useCaseFit.run-a-business: Sends email campaigns to the customers a small business already has.
